bio: Asprill led the legendary Tenth Legion and won the position of High Sentinel, guardian of the Celestial Palace – a cushy post, if she let herself relax. Asprill… did not. With few immediate attackers, she has taken up a more proactive defense: none can attack the Palace if none can reach it alive.
